column1: # Native SDK functions (runtime/*.c): what each argument register r3-r10 is, for recomp.py ptr_summaries.
# value = a number (not reached through); ptr N = a guest address, bytes [p, p + N) touched during the call;
# unknown = address with no fixed extent or kept for later (reached [p, INF)); ret = returns an argument-derived
# value (the native keeps recomp.py's default rule). Classified 2026-10-25 against runtime/*.c (evidence column).
